data.description:
I received the "Laurea" Bachelor degree in 2016 and the "Laurea Magistrale" Master degree in 2019 in Computer Science Engineering at Roma Tre University. I got my PhD at Roma Tre University in the Computer Networks and Security Research Group. I then joined the NSLab Research Group at KTH Royal Institute of Technology as a Postdoctoral Researcher.

Currently, I am a Senior Researcher in RISE (Research Institutes of Sweden).

My research mainly focuses on high-speed networking and programmable networks, with a particular focus on networking for AI, and applications of LLMs in the networking area.
